bk.bad: The file does not contain DagaDyn settings.
bk.note: Save the panel settings (playback, new tracks, appearance) to a file, to keep a copy or share them. Animations are not included: they live in the model. Importing replaces the current values; language and detail level stay as they are.
cv.all_done: Curve applied to all the transitions of the track
cv.tips: Drag the dots. Double-click on empty space: new dot. Double-click a dot: sharp or smooth corner. Right-click a dot: remove it. [Shift] while dragging: no grid.
cv.title: Transition curve
h.color_mix: OKLab: natural shades; RGB: direct blend of the values
h.curve_snap: Dots stop on the grid lines (Shift: free)
h.edit_preview: Changing a state's value shows the object in that state
h.follow_selection: The Object pane shows what you select in the model
h.new_duration: Transition duration of a new track
h.new_pivot: For objects animated for the first time
h.panel_fps: Times per second the panel follows playback
h.play_no_shadows: Shadows slow heavy models down a lot: they come back on pause and stop
h.play_repeat: When it ends, the timeline starts over
h.show_paths: In the view, the path of moving objects and their states (SketchUp 2023 and later)
h.stop_restore: On stop, objects go back to the project state; when off, they stay where they are (like “Keep”)
h.ui_accent: Buttons, active tabs, sliders and switches
h.ui_animations: Transitions on buttons, tabs and switches
h.ui_custom_colors: Replace the theme colours with the two below
h.ui_hints: The short line under each setting name
h.with_dagawasd: Objects also move while walking, exploring, on paths and in videos; the Use key starts them
help.1: Select a group, a component or a section plane; in Animation › Object add a property: move, position, rotation, size, scale, colour, opacity, visibility, tag.
help.2: For each property: start state, end state and duration. “+ Add a state” continues the sequence; “⌖ current” takes the value the object has in the model.
help.3: Click the small curve to open the editor: drag the dots to speed up, slow down, overshoot and come back, bounce.
help.4: [▶] plays all the animations of the model, [⏸] stops them where they are, the timeline bar shows any moment. [Space] in the panel: Play/Pause.
help.5: [⏹] puts everything back: while animating the project does not change and the file always saves the rest state. “Keep” instead keeps the current state.
help.6: Animations live inside the objects: they are saved in the .skp file and copied with the object.
help.7: "Starts": with the timeline, after another object has finished (plus a wait), or when it is used: with the [☝ Use] tool or with the Use key while walking in DagaWASD.
help.8: With DagaWASD objects also move while walking, exploring, on paths and in videos; moving platforms carry you along. The dot next to a state shows the object in that state.
help.intro: DagaDyn makes objects dynamic: any property of a group or component goes from one state to another over the time you choose, along a curve you decide, and you see it happen in the scene.
help.title: What is DagaDyn?
lang.note: The language applies to this panel and to the messages in SketchUp's status bar. Your choice is saved with the other settings.
log.badge: Errors recorded: click to view them
log.note: Internal errors are recorded here, one entry per distinct error, with the first lines of the call stack. If something does not work as expected, copy the log and send it along with a description of what happened.
log.title: Error log
lvl.h2: Also fine-tuning of playback and curves
lvl.hidden_mod: Contains modified settings hidden at the current level
ob.axes_h: The object's axes turn with it; the model's stay fixed
ob.empty: No animated properties. Pick one below: for each you set the start state, the end state, the duration and the curve.
ob.faces: Also faces with their own material
ob.faces_h: Colour and opacity also change painted faces, not only those with the default material
ob.faces_shared: This component is used several times: the faces of its copies change too.
ob.make_group: Make a group from the selection
ob.multi_all: Changes apply to all {n} selected objects
ob.multi_h: The others get the same tracks: positions and sizes adapted to each, everything else the same.
ob.none: Select a group or a component in the model to animate it.
ob.pivot_h: The point that stays still when the object changes size, that it rotates around and whose position is animated
ob.raw: The selection is not a group or a component: only those can be animated.
rt.busy: DagaDyn: DagaWASD is recording a video, playing a path or exploring; the animation waits until it is done
rt.nothing: DagaDyn: no animated objects in the model
rt.use_hint: DagaDyn: click an object to use it · Esc to quit
sc.empty: No animated objects in the model.
sc.note: The animated objects of the model. Click one to select it and edit its tracks.
st.act_h: Restarts from the beginning, or goes forward and back the next time (doors, drawers)
st.after_h: Starts when this object has finished its animation
st.use_h: Use tool: click the object in the model to start it
tip.stop: Stop the animations and put the objects back at rest
tip.use: Use tool: a click starts the objects that start "when used"
tp.bake_h: Stop and keep the objects as they are now (undo with Ctrl+Z)
tp.empty: No objects on the timeline: they start when you use them
tp.scrub: Drag to see any moment of the animation
tp.stop: Stop: back to the project state
tr.rest_h: Use the value the object has in the model
tr.see_h: Show the object in this state
